paper_mainline: Cross-Missing Representation Stability (not Hyper-Guided Dynamic Fusion)
next_gate: CONDITIONAL GO locked (2026-09-13). Phase=paper_validation. Evidence Package v1 frozen. Next: fair nearest-neighbor verification (HME/CMAD/LNLN) on explicit go — then IEMOCAP — then final paper. No SOTA chasing.
locked_claim_en: B3 reduces the average cross-missing representation drift and slightly alleviates performance degradation, with the most evident improvements observed under text-related missing patterns.
locked_claim_zh: B3 能够在总体上降低跨缺失模式的表征漂移并缓解性能退化，但其收益具有明显的缺失模式依赖性，在文本相关缺失场景下更为明显。
boxed_summary: H0+B3 on MOSEI shows limited but directionally consistent improvement in cross-missing representation stability.
forbidden: B3 eliminates representation drift under all missing patterns
allowed: CMRP-MSA achieves competitive reported-level performance on MOSEI (not fair SOTA)
Representation stability and performance robustness show consistent co-improvement trends
key_findings: MOSEI missAvg dMAE: H0 0.0758 -> H0+B3 0.0746 (slightly smaller degradation).
MOSEI missAvg dCorr: H0 0.1970 -> H0+B3 0.1837 (mildly smaller correlation drop).
MOSEI D_cross mean(6): H0 0.6978 -> H0+B3 0.6785 (slightly down).
Largest D_cross drop on MOSEI: T-missing 0.8996->0.7879; T+V 0.9948->0.8937.
Not uniform: A-missing / T+A / A+V D_cross slightly increase under B3.
T+V MAE improves with B3 (0.8296->0.8144) alongside D_cross drop — partial support for claim.
MOSI missAvg dMAE: H0 0.1578 -> H0+B3 0.1312 (lower degradation), but runs are not paired for D_cross.
Multi-seed MOSEI HB3 missMAE 0.7335±0.0012; MOSI PB HB3 missMAE 1.2755±0.0250 (seeds 42/43/44).
Lambda neighborhood {0,0.005,0.01,0.02}: chosen 0.005 for lowest missAvg MAE.
F2 is auxiliary keeper on MOSEI seed42; F3/F3n fail vs F2/F0 — fusion demoted.
Do not claim outperforms HME/CMAD/EASE; reported table is context only.
